Name: Chest Values
Author: MysticalAsian
Description:
Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[size=4]How to use:[/size]
[list]
[*]Hover your cursor over a chest to see its value
[*]You can customize the display through the config file or with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- [b]Mouse Position[/b]: [b]1[/b]: for below the cursor; [b]2[/b]: above the cursor, [b]3[/b]: left of the cursor, [b]4[/b]: right of the cursor
﻿ ﻿- Can toggle text on or off
﻿ ﻿- [b]Text Background Transparency[/b]: values 0 - 1

Manifest.Name: Chest Values
Manifest.Description: Allows you to view the total value of all the items within a chest
